question: Does certified e-graph feedback improve LLM monitor soundness, observable-fault detection and cost under fixed stimuli?

scope.ip: ZipCPU sfifo disclosed equivalence stress variant
scope.semantics: binary/two-state; empty data unspecified; synchronous active-high reset; no read/write during reset

development.feedback: compile errors, candidate activation/failure/unknown on fixed correct-control traces only; no mutant or held-out outcome

heldout.release: only after all six final candidate hashes frozen; no further candidate revision

formal.failure_policy: UNKNOWN/ERROR/TIMEOUT retained; bounded PASS never reported as unbounded proof

primary_metrics: suite soundness on independently validated correct controls
observable mutant recall gated by zero correct-control false alarms
valid distinct mutant kills per 1000 API input-plus-output tokens
secondary_metrics: formal soundness, counterexamples and cover reachability
eligibility: fixed final stimulus activates changed RTL behavior and independent reference reports a public-I/O specification violation; empirical divergence alone is insufficient
invalid_candidate_policy: retain attempts and costs; no last-minute repair using final outcomes; missing final candidate scores zero valid kills with invalid status
session_policy: fresh independent session per arm/repetition; exact same development artifacts; rotate arm order; no provider model substitution
selection_policy: use existing FIFO without conditioning on new B/C outcomes; exploratory one-IP synthetic-redundancy study, not independent natural-IP replication
oracle_role: claude-opus-5-5 specification-only author plus fresh read-only review; isolated from candidate sessions
source_policy: upstream FORMAL sections blanked while preserving line numbers; no functional RTL change; prove correspondence and retain transformation manifest
coverage_policy: precompute fixed DUT-only raw counters with original identities and counts; candidate monitor never changes their values or denominator; initialization/reset included consistently and reported
causality_limits: C has extra semantic tokens; equal caps do not equal actual prompt lengths
no length placebo in this B-prime/C-prime pilot
equivalent implementation expressions do not prove specification correctness
